channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Stocks will tumble much further as AI investment will slow next year then fall in 2028 and drag GDP down too, economist predicts
item.description: Capital Economics expects the S&P 500 will be 12% below its current level by the end of 2027, putting it 17% off its early-October peak.

item.title: Holiday fares hit a 10-year high. A Black Friday deal may only get you back to last year’s price
item.description: Hopper says Thanksgiving airfare averages $402, up 31%. A travel agent explains why Travel Tuesday bundles beat Black Friday flash sales.

item.title: Gen Z pushes back on ‘performative availability’ as only 8% of workers say it won them a promotion
item.description: In a survey of 1,006 U.S. workers, 69% said staying reachable after hours hasn’t helped their careers. Gen Z feels the least pressure to try.

item.title: The average worker would need to save for 52 years to claw their way out of the middle class and be classified as wealthy, research reveals
item.description: Bleak research warns not even a lifetime of savings would be enough to lift workers out of the middle class into the top 10%.
